description: Evaluates a JavaScript expression in the page of the remote authoring browser, not on this machine, and returns its value. Use it to read a data point from the DOM, check sign-in state, or trigger the target request (for example, `location.reload()`). The page cannot reach files or processes on this machine. Return only the values you need, never cookies or tokens. A result longer than 20000 characters comes back truncated (objects as JSON text) with `valueTruncation`; page with `offset`, or pass `maxChars` or `full`.

full.description: Return the whole text, ignoring `maxChars`. It can be megabytes, so prefer paging with `offset`.

offset.description: Character offset to start from, such as a previous `nextOffset`. Default 0.

name: eval_in_page
